caption_en: Absolute heading freedom under proprioceptive sensing. (a) Seven stored runs of the same IMU and foot-contact data, initialized at yaw angles from −150° to +150°, give rotated trajectories in an arbitrary local frame. The 0° and ±100° runs are highlighted; dots denote the common start and individual endpoints. (b) Their unwrapped yaw histories retain the initial offsets. The inset shows yaw increments over an input-selected 0.216 s two-contact interval; all seven curves overlap. (c) The saved observability spectra of the bias-augmented model for five preselected contact intervals, each divided by its own largest singular value and ordered from smallest to largest. Two four-contact and three two-contact windows contain 27 and 21 state dimensions, respectively. The first four singular directions fall below the relative rank threshold (dashed line, 10⁻⁹), consistently with three global translations and one global yaw degree of freedom. Different markers denote different windows. Removing only each run’s initial rotation gives a maximum position discrepancy of 1.90 × 10⁻⁷ m. The experiment demonstrates equivalent global orientations under the same proprioceptive observations.
caption_zh: 机器人自身观测下的绝对航向自由度。（a）同一组 IMU 与足端接触数据的七次已保存运行，初始航向覆盖 −150° 至 +150°，在任意局部坐标系中形成相互旋转的轨迹。彩色突出 0° 与 ±100°，圆点表示共同起点与各轨迹终点。（b）展开后的航向演化保留初始方向差异；插图为预先根据输入选定的 0.216 s 双接触窗口内航向增量，七条曲线重合。（c）含偏置模型在五个预选接触窗口的已保存可观测性奇异值，分别除以各自最大奇异值，并按从小到大排序。两段四接触与三段双接触窗口分别对应 27 维和 21 维状态；前四个方向均低于相对秩阈值（虚线，10⁻⁹），对应三维全局平移与一维全局航向自由度。不同标记表示不同窗口。仅消除各运行初始旋转后，最大位置差为 1.90 × 10⁻⁷ m。该组实验验证同一自身观测下全局方向的等价性。
meaning_zh: 读图顺序：左图说明同样自身观测可以对应多个全局方向；右上说明初始方向差异在时间中保留，而局部航向变化相同；右下给出这一现象的结构来源。它支持论文对外部绝对方向约束的需求。

technical_notes.claim: The IMU/contact system constrains relative motion but has a global yaw gauge freedom.
technical_notes.absolute_yaw_definition: degrees(unwrap(atan2(R10,R00))); conventional local Euler yaw, opposite the archived angle around the downward gravity vector.
technical_notes.trajectory_frame: arbitrary local x/y; not geodetic East/North
technical_notes.inset_definition: psi(t)-psi(t_window_start), input-selected highest-excitation two-contact interval WIN003
technical_notes.spectrum: all singular values of the stored bias-augmented raw structural model; per-window largest-value normalization; ascending rank does not denote matching physical modes across dimensions
technical_notes.other_read_spectra: bias-free and column-normalized diagnostic spectra fully read in profile, not drawn to avoid repeating the same structural claim

visual_review_notes.a: Seven real saved native trajectories are all shown. Initial-yaw legend uses distinct line styles, with blue zero-yaw anchor. World axes are arbitrary, equal metric scale; no reference trajectory or accuracy claim.
visual_review_notes.b: Seven native unwrapped yaw histories show the initial offsets. Inset shows all 43 samples in a preselected input window, each subtracting its own window-start yaw. Curves overlap at plotting resolution. Insets do not cover main curves.
visual_review_notes.c: All 117 singular values of the bias-augmented raw structural model are displayed across five windows. Relative threshold, four smallest directions and different state dimensions are explicit. Blue/orange families also use distinct marker families in grayscale.
visual_review_notes.grayscale: Actually viewed the grayscale preview. Pattern and marker redundancy remain legible; seven yaw traces are distinguished by their offsets and line styles.
visual_review_notes.collision_warning: The sole text-image-edge warning concerns inset tick 4 against the rectangular bounding box of a rasterized parent-curve layer. Actual curves are absent behind this tick; confirmed in color/grayscale previews. No text-text or text-stroke failure.
